topic: Food trucks: a site that tells the desert where you're parked today
caption:
Hungry customers won't hunt you down. They'll just buy somewhere else. A food truck site can post your location daily, show your menu, and answer every question before they even leave the house. We build them fast, keep them simple, and make sure Google knows you exist. Link in bio.
